detail.longDescription: Google Meet is baked into just about everything Google makes—including Google Calendar, where it's the default video conferencing option on every event you create. If Meet isn't your thing, though, you're not stuck with it. Here's how to add Zoom to Google Calendar (and make it the default meeting option).
